t: The one that every collection opens with
a: الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّةِ، وَلِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ
p: Al-aʿmālu bi-n-niyyah, wa li-kulli-mriʾin mā nawā. Fa-man kānat hijratuhu ilā-Llāhi wa rasūlih, fa-hijratuhu ilā-Llāhi wa rasūlih
m: Actions are by intention, and every person has what he intended. So whoever emigrated to Allah and His Messenger, his emigration was to Allah and His Messenger.
